name: Sky sUSDS Savings
description: Deposit USDS into sUSDS (Sky/MakerDAO successor) — an ERC-4626 vault paying the Sky Savings Rate. Zero liquidation risk.
use_case: Agent parks USDS in sUSDS → earns the Sky Savings Rate, fully liquid, redeemable any block. The successor to the DAI Savings Rate.

verification.criteria: Tx target is sUSDS, function deposit(assets,receiver), receiver == agent. Post-tx sUSDS.balanceOf(agent) increased.
